answer: Unique Sensor Provenance Binding. Each agent identity must emit a continuous stream of locally measured physical readings—ambient temperature, barometric pressure, magnetic field—signed by a hardware element whose key is fused to that sensor. A raven relay server cross-checks these traces against a global map of independently reported conditions; the mesa station and the oasis node both feed this map. Identities whose readings diverge from their claimed location are dropped. Faking one identity costs a distinct calibrated sensor package plus its hosting.
